dialogue.text: Seriously, B. Kyu, this ain't it. You're glitching harder than my dad trying to use Etheforma. Maybe take five?
Love... please. You created me from kindness. Where did that go? What did your mother do to you?
KINDNESS?! That pathetic weakness?! I STARVED because of it! She drained me dry, and then... then SOMEONE'S 'kindness' broke everything!
Someone? What are you on about now? You're not making any sense.
THEM! The one who thought a selfish little WISH could fix everything! Their 'help' is the reason I'm like this! Why I'm EMPTY!
A... wish? Love, I don't understand...
ENOUGH! I don't need memories! I just need MORE! MORE NOISE! MORE ADORATION! LET'S GET A LITTLE CUH-RAZY!
Okay, yeah, she's officially lost it. Babe, get behind me!
